channel.title: Mitchel Pawirodinomo
channel.description: Writing on infrastructure, Go tooling and side projects.

item.title: Building Onchain Stocks, a portfolio view for tokenized stocks on Base
item.description: Coinbase now issues stock tokens on Base, but wallets show them next to every airdropped scam token. So I built a static, read-only viewer that shows those 40 tokens and nothing else, and made it load in about half a second on a slow phone.

item.title: Exposing local services with Cloudflare Tunnel
item.description: No port forwarding, no dynamic DNS, no home IP on the internet. How to put a local service on a real domain with cloudflared, and the catches worth knowing first.

item.title: Ditching Docker Desktop for Colima and Portainer
item.description: Docker Desktop is a lot of app for what I actually use. Colima gives me the Docker daemon, Portainer gives me the dashboard, and my compose files didn't notice the difference.

item.title: Building CryptoWatcher: the macOS Stocks widget, in my terminal
item.description: A weekend project in Go with Bubble Tea: widget cards, Braille line charts and one watchlist for crypto and stocks, pulled from three different price feeds.

item.title: Building Cashly, my self-hosted finance tracker
item.description: Why I stopped using budget apps and built my own: a Go daemon on SQLite that reads bank alert emails, tracks fiat and crypto in one place, and has an assistant that can undo its own mistakes.

item.title: Why I built bcron: a scheduler I can actually see
item.description: Scheduled jobs that fail silently, with output nobody kept. bcron is a small Go scheduler with a background daemon, SQLite history and a terminal UI.

item.title: Scraping 8 Surinamese banks without losing my mind
item.description: None of the banks in Suriname have a rates API, so I built ForexSU to scrape them. Notes on parsers that survive redesigns, serving stale data on purpose, and why it's a PWA.
